outgoing.name: Alcohol
outgoing.excerpt: Alcohol is cheap due to low excise duty in Sikkim.

outgoing.name: Beer
outgoing.excerpt: Beer, whiskey, rum and brandy are frequently consumed by both locals and non-locals.

outgoing.name: Capital
outgoing.excerpt: Gangtok pronunciation ( Nepali/Hindi: गंगटोक) is the capital and largest town of the Indian state of Sikkim.

outgoing.name: Cricket
outgoing.excerpt: Football (soccer) and cricket are the two most popular sports.

outgoing.name: Electricity
outgoing.excerpt: It also has an almost uninterrupted electricity supply due to Sikkim's numerous hydroelectric power stations, and has the state's only cardiac hospital.

outgoing.name: Football (soccer)
outgoing.excerpt: Football (soccer) and cricket are the two most popular sports.

outgoing.name: Hindi
outgoing.excerpt: Gangtok pronunciation ( Nepali/Hindi: गंगटोक) is the capital and largest town of the Indian state of Sikkim.

outgoing.name: Hinduism
outgoing.excerpt: Hinduism and Muslims are the two largest religions in Gangtok.

outgoing.name: Indian independence movement
outgoing.excerpt: Following India's independence in 1947, Sikkim became a nation-state with Gangtok as its capital.

outgoing.name: Mosque
outgoing.excerpt: A mosque in downtown Gangtok also serves the small Muslim minority.

outgoing.name: Sunflower
outgoing.excerpt: Sunflower, marigold, poinsettia, and other flowers bloom in November and December.

outgoing.name: Television
outgoing.excerpt: The city's main landmark is a 200 foot (90 m) TV tower that can be viewed from afar.

outgoing.name: Temperate
outgoing.excerpt: Because of its elevation and sheltered environment, Gangtok enjoys a mild, temperate climate all year round.

outgoing.name: Tree
outgoing.excerpt: The Jawaharlal Nehru Botanical Gardens, near Rumtek, houses many species of bamboo and as many as fifty different species of tree, including many oaks.

outgoing.name: University
outgoing.excerpt: Gangtok does not have a university within the city limits.

outgoing.name: Watch
outgoing.excerpt: Its economy does not have a manufacturing base, but cottage industries such as watch-making, country-made alcohol and handicrafts are present.
